items.title: Rotate session-headed ledgers using real UTF-8 byte budgets
items.why: The live SIL and WORK_LOG use session-first headings, which DATE_HEADER never recognizes. The planner also uses string.length for byte thresholds.
items.recipe: Extend the existing ledger parser for explicitly dated session headings, retain undated blocks, calculate UTF-8 bytes, and archive an immutable hash-addressed full preimage before mutating dated ledgers. Add real CLI regressions in isolated roots and reuse the existing self-test suite.
items.acceptance: Session-first and date-first dated entries rotate oldest-first; undated sections and complete recent entries stay hot; Unicode sizes use UTF-8 bytes; real CLI fixtures preserve the exact preimage, archive every removed complete block, refuse conflicting archives, and rerun idempotently. Full source checks and authorized staging/production acceptance remain required.
items.userOutcome: Reliable bounded handoffs let maintenance agents find recent website release facts without silently dropping historical evidence.
items.stageRationale: Repair reproduced tooling failure without altering membership, identity, visual design or public promises.
